title: 第3章 恶棍的威胁第4章 以恶制恶
slug: 寡村寡事第446章后山的驴
content_zh:
柳大春正俯身之时，师娘杨桃花缓缓苏醒过来。
“师娘，你醒了？”柳大春当即欢喜，心中也稍有愧疚，好在自己刚刚没有干出过分之事。
“大春？你？”师娘杨桃花不可思议的看着柳大春，这傻徒儿不是被赵大发扔入枯井砸死了吗？怎么？
“师娘，我没事，那枯井下面是干的，我在中间卡住了，所以没有受伤。”柳大春撒谎解释道。
“哦。”
师娘坐了起来，摸了摸自己的头，头剧痛。
“傻徒儿怎么了？”师娘杨桃花见傻子的目光怪怪的，像一个男人看自己。
师娘杨桃花的脸瞬间就通红了，敲了敲柳大春的脑袋，笑道：“你个傻徒儿，师娘美吗？”
“美，美。”柳大春连连点头。
“呵呵。”师娘杨桃花笑了，桃花满面，说道：“傻徒儿，你懂什么呀，可惜你是个傻子！”
师娘杨桃花直勾勾地看了这个傻徒儿一眼，自从丈夫死后，这小药馆中落，落寂了许多。
这时。
外面有人喊了起来。
“杨桃花？”
一听这声音，杨桃花就打了个寒颤。
“是老村长那个王八蛋来了，你快躲躲，我去应付他。”杨桃花急忙把衣服整理好，理了理头发，准备出去。
如果被那个老色逼看见自己衣冠不整，只怕又是一阵上手。
“师娘，我跟你一起去。”柳大春说道。
“傻徒儿，你还是别去了，上次他打断了你的腿，他肯定又带那两个龙虎保镖来的，我怕你出事。”师娘杨桃花关心道。
“师娘，我腿好了，如果我不去，你一个人去，那个色老头肯定会欺负你的。”柳大春很清楚老村长的品性，村里不少村妇都遭殃过。

听了这话，师娘杨桃花这才反应过来，诧异地看着柳大春，惊道：“傻徒儿，你说话，怎么利索了？”
没等柳大春解释，外面老村长又大喊起来。
“那行吧，你躲在师娘后面。”杨桃花那是很护着这个傻徒儿的。
两个人出了正厅，院内，那老村长，带着他的两个贴身龙虎保镖，正阔步走了进来。
这老村长五十多岁的年纪，络腮胡须，一张凶狠脸，体型健硕，平日里就喜欢欺负寡妇。
后方跟着的两个龙虎保镖接近190米的身高，体型如蒙古大汉，总是穿着一身定制的黑色大师服，一个纹着龙，一个纹着虎。
此龙虎兄弟自称少林龙虎拳传人，跟着老村长也是为非作歹。
老村长曹御看到杨桃花，目光就色眯眯了起来，在杨桃花的身上游离。
杨桃花的衬衣半透明的，那种隐隐约约之美，更是让男人欲罢不能的。
“这嫂子还穿得这么搔，正他妈的带劲！！”老村长已经有些热起来了，早就想把这个女人给办了。
这老村长带人来，马上就有看热闹的村民围观过来了，密密麻麻的不少人呢。
“老村长，有什么事吗？”师娘杨桃花问道，虽然话语没有哆嗦，但语气明显信心不足。
“没啥事，我们来呢，是想告诉你，你们家承包的玉米地我要收回来。”老村长说道。
“这和你有什么关系？”师娘杨桃花问道。
“当然有关系，你老公死前给我治病，结果把我治残了，我腰现在还痛，当初让你们赔钱，现在都没给我，那没办法了，我只能把你们家的玉米地给收了，合情合理吧。”老村长嘚瑟地说道。
“你真是会胡说八道，我老公只是给你开了常见的感冒药，大家都是这么吃的，他们都没问题，偏偏就你有问题？”
“而且，你说你腰疼，你有什么证据证明你腰疼是我家药方子导致的？你是不是太不讲理了？”师娘杨桃花当即反驳道。
“啧啧啧！”老村长摆出一副很嫌弃的样子，说道：“杨桃花，我说是，那就是，懂吗？我赵天虎什么时候讲过道理？不讲道理就对了！！”
“杨桃花，我告诉你，摆你面前的就三条路，一赔钱；二做我小妾，看在是我小妾的份上，我可以网开一面，哈哈。”
赵天虎嘚瑟的大笑起来。

那两个龙虎保镖也跟着哈哈大笑。
“你！”师娘杨桃花已经气死了。
“这第三吗，你也可以选，镇上的窑子也是我开的，我把你卖到窑子里去，要是你工作勤奋点，指不定几年就把债还清了哦。哈哈。”赵天虎猥琐着笑着。

When Liu Dachun was leaning over, Master Yang Taohua slowly came to life.
"Master's wife, are you awake?" Liu Dachun was immediately happy and felt a little guilty in his heart. Fortunately, he had not done anything excessive just now.
"Dachun? You?" Master Yang Taohua looked at Liu Dachun in disbelief. Wasn't this stupid disciple thrown into a dry well by Zhao Dafa and killed? how?
"Master's wife, I'm fine. The bottom of the dry well is dry. I got stuck in the middle, so I wasn't injured." Liu Dachun lied and explained.
"Oh."
The mistress sat up and touched her head, which felt severe pain.
"What's wrong with the stupid disciple?" Yang Taohua, the master's wife, saw that the stupid man looked at her strangely, like a man looking at her.
Master Yang Taohua's face instantly turned red. She knocked Liu Dachun on the head and said with a smile, "You silly disciple, isn't Master beautiful?"
"Beautiful, beautiful." Liu Dachun nodded repeatedly.
"Haha." Master Yang Taohua smiled, her face full of peach blossoms, and said: "Foolish disciple, what do you know? It's a pity that you are a fool!"
Yang Taohua, the master's wife, looked directly at this stupid disciple. Since her husband's death, this small pharmacy has fallen into a state of silence.
At this time.
Someone shouted outside.
"Carambola blossom?"
Upon hearing this voice, Yang Taohua shuddered.
"That bastard, the old village chief, is here. Hurry and hide while I deal with him." Yang Taohua hurriedly put her clothes in order, straightened her hair, and prepared to go out.
If that old pervert sees me disheveled, I'm afraid he'll start to take advantage of her again.
"Master's wife, I'll go with you." Liu Dachun said.
"Stupid disciple, you better not go. He broke your leg last time. He must have brought those two dragon and tiger bodyguards with him again. I'm afraid something will happen to you." Yang Taohua, the master's wife, said with concern.
"Master Wife, my legs are healed. If I don't go and you go alone, that perverted old man will definitely bully you." Liu Dachun knew the old village chief's character very well, and many village women in the village had suffered from it.
After hearing this, Master Yang Taohua reacted, looked at Liu Dachun in surprise, and said in surprise: "Silly disciple, how come you speak so fluently?"
Before Liu Dachun could explain, the old village chief shouted again outside.
"Okay, you hide behind the master's wife." Yang Taohua was very protective of this stupid disciple.
The two people walked out of the main hall. In the courtyard, the old village chief strode in with his two personal dragon and tiger bodyguards.
The old village chief was in his fifties, with a beard, a fierce face, and a strong build. He liked to bully widows on weekdays.
The two dragon and tiger bodyguards following behind are nearly 190 meters tall and built like a Mongolian man. They always wear a customized black master uniform, one with a dragon tattoo and the other with a tiger tattoo.
The Dragon and Tiger brothers claim to be the successors of Shaolin Dragon and Tiger Fist, and they follow the old village chief to do evil.
When the old village chief Cao Yu saw Yang Taohua, his eyes narrowed and wandered around her body.
Yang Taohua's shirt is translucent, and her vague beauty makes men unable to stop.
"This sister-in-law is so damn exciting when she's wearing such a shabby dress!!" The old village chief was already getting a little excited and wanted to deal with this woman for a long time.
The old village chief brought people here, and immediately there were villagers watching the fun, and there were many densely packed people.
"Old village chief, what's the matter?" Master Yang Taohua asked. Although her words were not trembling, her tone was obviously lacking in confidence.
"It's okay. We are here to tell you that I want to take back the cornfield contracted by your family." said the old village chief.
"What does this have to do with you?" Master Yang Taohua asked.
"Of course it does matter. Your husband treated me before he died, but he ended up making me disabled. My waist still hurts. I asked you to compensate me at first, but now you haven't paid me. So there is nothing I can do. I can only harvest your cornfield. It's reasonable, right?" the old village chief said coquettishly.
"You are really good at talking nonsense, my husband just gives youI was prescribed common cold medicine, and everyone took it this way, and they were fine, but you were the only one who had a problem? "
"Furthermore, you said you have back pain, what evidence do you have to prove that your back pain is caused by my prescription? Are you being too unreasonable? "Master's wife Yang Taohua immediately retorted.
“Tsk tsk tsk! The old village chief put on a look of disgust and said, "Yang Taohua, if I say yes, that's right, do you understand?" When did I, Zhao Tianhu, ever speak the truth? It’s okay to be unreasonable! ! "
"Yang Taohua, let me tell you, there are only three ways in front of you, one is to lose money; the other is to be my concubine, for the sake of being my concubine, I can be lenient, haha. "
Zhao Tianhu laughed loudly.
The two dragon and tiger bodyguards also laughed.
"You! "Master Yang Taohua is already furious.
"This is the third one. You can also choose. I also run the kiln in the town. I will sell you to the kiln. If you work harder, you may be able to pay off the debt in a few years. Ha ha. "Zhao Tianhu smiled obscenely.
